openers.name: The Oversized First Word (drop-cap display open)
openers.mechanism: The heading's first word is promoted to a display-size block that sits on its own line at page_masthead scale while the remainder runs inline after it at section_heading scale — the word itself becomes the section signpost, no label needed. Applied via a <span className="efsw-openword"> on the first word; no extra markup or copy changes. Motion: the open word uses the existing data-reveal="clip" left-to-right wipe, rest of the heading fades one tick later (80ms).

openers.name: The Marginal Note (hairline rule + inset annotation)
openers.mechanism: A 1px horizontal hairline in --efsw-gradient-line (mint→teal→sun) spans the column, and a small right-aligned annotation in caption_meta scale (0.65-0.75rem, weight 650, 0.08em tracking, --efsw-ink-soft) sits on/above the line's right end carrying factual dateline info (region, year, language triad) — provenance moves to the margin, typography carries the centre. Content column insets 1rem below the rule. Not a kicker: it is right-aligned, off-axis, and factual rather than taxonomic.

openers.name: The Lone Statement (surface flip + one typed line)

peaks.name: DeanMessage — Portrait Kerning Wobble
peaks.file: components/efsw/DeanMessage.tsx (+ components/efsw/DeanMessage.css for the clip-path keyframe; GSAP already a dependency)
peaks.trigger: ScrollTrigger.create on the .dean-message section, start 'top 75%', once: true — fires one time when the portrait scrolls into view; also re-arm on profile change (currentSlide) so each dean's first appearance gets the gesture
peaks.props: No new props needed — reuse existing profiles[] and currentProfile; optional wobble?: boolean prop default true to let admin disable per profile
peaks.steps: 1) Add a ref to .dean-message__portrait-frame and one to .dean-message__name. 2) In a useEffect keyed on currentSlide, inside a gsap.context: gsap.fromTo(nameRef, {letterSpacing:'-0.06em'} ,{keyframes:[{letterSpacing:'-0.02em',duration:0.35},{letterSpacing:'-0.03em',duration:0.35}], ease:'cubic-bezier(0.6,-0.28,0.735,0.045)' (--ease-back), scrollTrigger:{trigger:sectionRef,start:'top 75%',once:true}}) — total 700ms. 3) Portrait: gsap.fromTo(frameRef, {clipPath:'inset(8% 8% 8% 8% round 50%)'},{clipPath:'inset(0% 0% 0% 0% round 50%)', duration:0.9, ease:'power3.out'} (map --ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)) same trigger. 4) Gate both tweens on window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') → set final values immediately. 5) Everything else in the section stays still — remove no other animation; this is the single authored moment on the home page mid-section. 6) letterSpacing animation on a styled h2: ensure the base style is letterSpacing:-0.03em so the wobble settles into the token.

peaks.name: About Reach Stats — Counter Draw-In
peaks.file: app/about/page.tsx (.efsw-about-reach section, reach stats currently render static {value} at line 72); styles at app/globals.css:7008-7040 (.efsw-reach-stat strong already weight 700, display font)

peaks.steps: 1) Add font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums to .efsw-reach-stat strong in globals.css so digits don't jitter during the count. 2) Add an ::after or explicit <span className="efsw-reach-rule" /> 1px rule under each strong (width 100%, background var(--efsw-gradient-line) at 40% alpha). 3) In a small client island (the section is currently server-rendered; extract ReachStats as 'use client'): useEffect → IO threshold 0.75 once → for each stat gsap.fromTo(counterObj,{v:0},{v:final, duration:1.2, ease:'expo.out' (--ease-expo cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1)), onUpdate:setText(Math.round)}); 150ms later gsap.fromTo(rule,{scaleX:0},{scaleX:1,duration:0.8,ease:'power3.out',transformOrigin:'left center'}). 4) Reduced motion: render final integer + scaleX(1), skip tweens. 5) SSR/SEO: server-render the final value inside <strong>, hydrate the counter over it (start from final, rewind to 0 only when animation actually runs) so content is never gated on JS.

hard_rules: Kicker above heading is a BAN, not a default: .efsw-kicker / .efsw-section-label never open a section again (auteur rule 6). The only allowed labels are: the single .efsw-hero__kicker brand tagline, the newsroom dateline strip, and inline per-item eyebrows (article category, history milestone). Opening a section = pick ONE of the 4 openers in this plan; never two on one page, never the same one twice on a page.

The identical spring-up reveal everywhere is the second-order slop: never let two sections on a page share the same entrance signature. .efsw-reveal (opacity 0, y:40, 800ms power3) is on the delete list — replace with the surface vocabulary (hero line-mask / editorial rise+unblur / grid stagger 60ms / fold / footer single rise). Budget: ≤3 scroll-motion families per page (home = hero, editorial, grid — at budget), ONE authored peak per page (home = DeanMessage wobble; newsroom = beam sweep; about = counter draw-in).

Type and motion tokens are singular, not per-section: fonts --font-display (Bricolage 650, tracking -0.015..-0.03em, display clamp ceiling 6.5rem; 8rem masthead/hero-wordmark exempt) and --font-body (Inter 400/450). Easings only --ease-expo (0.19,1,0.22,1) for entrances, --ease-out (0.16,1,0.3,1) for UI/scroll reveals, --ease-back for the one wobble. Before adding any animation, fix the duplicate :root token blocks in globals.css (lines 39-40 vs 351-363 and 3091-3092 Axion overrides) — two --font-display definitions is drift-by-construction.

Delete dead motion, don't layer over it: fadeRise/.animate-fade-rise trio, subtleFloat on non-hero surfaces, the per-section bespoke ScrollTriggers in lib/scroll-animations.ts (about-title/news-heading/footer), and the .efsw-reveal-group 150ms/0.7s power2 stagger all get removed as their replacements land — verify removal with a grep, and verify horizontalScroll/pinSection/createParallaxLayers exports stay unused (zero callers today) before deleting. Animate transform/opacity only; filter:blur allowed solely in the editorial family at ≤8px; ease-in is banned; UI durations 100-500ms, scroll reveals 500-1200ms.

Motion is progressive enhancement on a readable page: every reveal lands on an element that renders visible without JS (SSR keeps final copy in DOM; use initial={false} on framer-motion, gsap fromTo with immediateRender:false, IO fallbacks that add .is-visible). Every scrub/once tween checks prefers-reduced-motion and snaps to final state — reduced-motion is a gentler art direction, not a blank page. Every heading keeps an id + aria-labelledby wiring (pageSections rely on it), and trilingual EN/TH/KO strings stay in the locales, never hardcoded in these components.
